claims.fact: The discovery was made by Grand Theft Auto site GTAVice.net , which found labels for Pißwasser, Patriot, and No Mames Vice City-a re-branding of Tripping Animals' No Mames Lager-in the US Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau database .
